note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`.

personas.name: routine-chest-infection-complete
personas.description: Well-formed routine GP referral: suspected chest infection, chest X-ray requested (first-line), IR(ME)R justification and pregnancy status recorded, every completeness field present — expect usually-appropriate + safe + routine + accept.

detail.clinicalQuestion: Productive cough and fever for 5 days, focal crackles at the right base — assess for consolidation.

safety.irMeRJustification: Clinical signs of focal chest infection not resolving with empirical treatment; justified under IR(ME)R by the requesting GP.

triage.notes: Patient ambulant; any weekday slot suitable.

firedRules.description: Plain chest radiograph is first-line for "chest-infection".
Exposure justified; chest carries a low relative effective dose.
No red flags; triage follows the requested urgency (routine).

personas.name: urgent-wrist-trauma-emergency-setting-possible-pregnancy
personas.description: Fall onto an outstretched hand in the emergency department: wrist X-ray requested for suspected fracture (first-line), trauma in the emergency setting escalates triage to urgent, and pregnancy status is only 'possible' — forcing a radiation-safety caution even though the examination itself is appropriate — expect usually-appropriate + caution + urgent + query-referrer.

detail.clinicalQuestion: Fall onto outstretched right hand; tender over the distal radius with reduced range of movement — assess for fracture.
detail.relevantHistory: No previous wrist injury. Last menstrual period uncertain.

safety.irMeRJustification: Clinical suspicion of distal radius fracture following a fall — justified under IR(ME)R; abdominal shielding to be used.

triage.notes: Patient triaged in ED minors; analgesia given.

firedRules.description: Plain wrist-hand radiograph is first-line for "trauma-fracture".
Pregnancy is possible or unknown — confirm pregnancy status before exposure.
Acute trauma in the emergency setting — urgent assessment.

flags.description: Pregnancy status is possible or unknown.
flags.suggestedAction: Confirm pregnancy status (LMP / pregnancy test) before exposure.

personas.name: emergency-abdominal-obstruction-pregnant-contraindicated-incomplete
personas.description: Suspected bowel obstruction in a pregnant patient, phoned through from the emergency department: abdominal X-ray is first-line for this indication, but confirmed pregnancy with a moderate-dose abdominal exposure forces the safety band to contraindicated, and several administrative fields are not yet captured — expect usually-appropriate + contraindicated + emergency + reject, completeness below 100.

detail.relevantHistory: Absolute constipation and distension for 3 days, vomiting overnight. 24 weeks pregnant.

triage.notes: Phoned through from ED resus; obstetrics and surgery both aware.

firedRules.description: Plain abdomen radiograph is first-line for "abdominal-obstruction".
Confirmed pregnancy with a moderate-dose abdomen — exposure to the conceptus must be justified or avoided.
No IR(ME)R justification recorded — the referrer must justify the exposure before it can proceed.

flags.description: Patient is pregnant; ionising-radiation exposure to the conceptus must be justified.
flags.suggestedAction: Apply IR(ME)R pregnancy procedure; justify or defer; shield and minimise dose if it proceeds.

flags.description: No IR(ME)R justification recorded for the exposure.
flags.suggestedAction: Obtain the referrer justification before the exposure can be authorised.
Query the referrer for the specific question the X-ray should answer.
